image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing on a display stand in an indoor setting. The armor includes a breastplate, pauldrons (shoulder guards), faulds (waist protection), gauntlets, and greaves (leg armor). The breastplate is the central focus, featuring a high collar (gorget) and smooth, reflective surfaces with visible rivets and embossed details. The background shows a wooden cabinet and a framed picture.
